title_as_printed: Apparent molal volumes and heat capacities of alkaline earth chlorides in water at 25 C
pressure_note: not stated (atmospheric flow densimeter / flow microcalorimeter; pressure not given)

value.what: apparent molal heat capacity of the salt, derived from the measured relative volumetric specific heat and phi_V

value2.what: measured density difference of solution minus water (d0 = 0.997047 g/cm3); primary measurement

value3.what: apparent molal volume of the salt, derived from densities

composition.other_species: salt per block given by label row: MgCl2, CaCl2, SrCl2 (out of scope, rows kept), BaCl2 (out of scope, rows kept); molarity c also printed

extra_unmapped: c mol/L (molarity, converted by authors from molality with measured densities)
[(sigma - sigma0)/sigma0] x 10^3 (measured relative volumetric specific heat difference, dimensionless; sigma0 = 4.1793 J/K/cm3)
conversion_needs: the salt of each block is set by the label row: the m column belongs to MgCl2, CaCl2, SrCl2 or BaCl2 for that block
d - d0 is printed x10^3 g/cm3: multiply by 1e-3
notes: Blank cells: the first one or two (BaCl2) dilute rows of a block have only m, c, d-d0 and phi_V printed; heat-capacity columns were not obtained there. Rows 0-based over all data rows incl. label rows: Mg 1-9, Ca 11-18, Sr 20-28, Ba 30-38. Primary measured results are d-d0 and the sigma ratio; phi_V and phi_C are derived by the authors.
quality_remarks: The block label rows set the salt of each block (MgCl2, CaCl2, SrCl2, BaCl2); a base per-row MgCl2 mapping had overridden them, storing CaCl2, SrCl2 and BaCl2 rows as MgCl2 (found by the random audit, 2026-10-04). SrCl2 and BaCl2 are outside the six-ion set and are held.
